verdict.rationale: Trivy's docs say it detects exposed secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) in any container image and filesystem, with secret scanning on by default. It can also scan image configuration for secrets via `--image-config-scanners`, so Docker images and local filesystems are clearly covered. Missing for 10: any evidence of scanning S3 buckets or other cloud object storage for secrets, any evidence of scanning CI logs (filesystem scanning of exported logs is only implied), and independent hands-on confirmation of secret-detection quality.
